Summary:

Welcome to Your Beach Getaway at Inlet Beach!



Dog-Friendly: Your furry friends are welcome to join your beach adventure!

New 6-Seater Golf Cart: Explore the beach and surrounding areas with ease.



The Space:

Sleep Arrangements:



1st Floor:



Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed

Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa

Full Bathroom across the hall

2nd Floor:



Master Bedroom: King Bed with Private Full Bath

Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed

Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds

Full Hallway Bathroom



Interiors & Kitchen:



Open-concept living and dining area

Modern kitchen with high-end appliances

Keurig & filter coffee machines, NutriBullet Smoothie Maker

Professional-grade knives & assorted kitchen tools

Cozy living room furnishings with large Smart TV



Additional Features:



Comfortable office space for work & play

Large smart TVs in all bedrooms

Gas grill on the patio for outdoor dining

Full-size washer/dryer

Outdoor shower for post-beach cleanup



Guest Access:

Electronic keypad - code provided 5 days before check-in



The Neighborhood:

Situated in a small neighborhood, just minutes from the beach! Hang out at the community pool or head over to the beach for a relaxing day in the sun. Grab bikes and hit the Timpoochee Trail to discover the nearby communities of Inlet Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Alys Beach, or check out Lake Powell!
